villa-samagi.description:
Villa Samagi is an off-plan villa design from Maison Ceylon with 3 en-suite bedrooms, delivered turnkey and furnished (land and plot sourcing handled separately by Maison Ceylon). Private lap pool (3.5 x 10 m) included; an infinity pool upgrade (3.5 x 13 m) is available.

Sited on your choice of plot in Ahangama, Weligama, or Mirissa (Galle District) — Maison Ceylon sources and secures the specific plot after reservation.

Add-on option: Bungalow Ithiri, a self-contained 30 sqm studio with its own bathroom and kitchenette, can be added to this villa (it cannot be purchased as a standalone unit).
villa-samagi.summary: Off-plan 3-bedroom villa from Maison Ceylon, buildable on the south coast (Ahangama, Weligama, or Mirissa).
